# https://github.com/eiler2005/cheap-intelligence-toolkit

The toolkit for the book series "When Intelligence Became Cheap" by Denis Ermilov.
Generated from the Practicum at https://cheap-intelligence.vercel.app; that site is canonical and always newer.

- packs/ — every material for one book as a single file, for loading into an assistant
- playbooks/ — worksheets
- prompts/ — the prompt bank
- skills/ — SKILL.md files and browser tools
- docs/ — START, HOW-TO-USE, MAP
- en/ — the same in English, draft translation

Practicum version 1.2.0. Live pages are not mirrored here: read them at https://cheap-intelligence.vercel.app/watch.
